releaseNotes: Fixes a startup failure on the office PC. Recovery Hub refused to open with 'Could not auto-detect the customers sheet' whenever the billing workbook had no phone column - the sheet's own name was never looked at - and a customers-only roster with no payments sheet failed the migration as well. Both are fixed, so a plain customer list imports and the application starts. Last Balance Only is now on the office Billing page too, not just the phone. Paid receipts no longer count as unpaid: the History filters and the PAID/PARTIAL/UNPAID totals were measuring the money against the customer's carried-forward balance instead of the receipt's own charge, so a receipt settled in full read as unpaid whenever the customer already owed something.
